question: In MS-Word 365, Ctrl + E is the keyboard shortcut to _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __option 2__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Ctrl + Y is used to perform a "redo" operation in MS-Word.
 
• Ctrl + Z is used to perform an "undo" operation in MS-Word.
 
• Undo means to cancel or reverse the effects or results of (a previous action or measure).
 
• Redo means to do (something) again or differently.
 
• Center the text - Ctrl+E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__Important Shortcut keys used in MS Word__:

 
• Cut the selected content to the Clipboard - Ctrl+X
 
• Copy the selected content to the Clipboard - Ctrl+C
 
• Paste the contents of the Clipboard -Ctrl+V
 
• Increase the font size by 1 point.- Ctrl+]
 
• Align the text to the left - Ctrl+L.
